description: This file defines the 'Note' entity class for an Android application, representing a note in the Nextcloud Notes app. It includes fields for note properties, annotations for database mapping, and methods for accessing and modifying note data.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note in the database, with properties such as title, content, category, and metadata like modified date, favorite status, and sharing options.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: isShared
methods.description: Checks if the note is shared.

methods.name: setIsShared
methods.description: Sets the shared status of the note.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the note.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the category of the note.

methods.name: getRemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote ID associated with the note, if any.

methods.name: setRemoteId
methods.description: Sets the remote ID associated with the note.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with the note.

methods.name: setAccountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID associated with the note.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the database status of the note.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the database status of the note.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns the last modified date of the note.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified date of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.

methods.name: getReadonly
methods.description: Checks if the note is read-only.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the read-only status of the note.

methods.name: getFavorite
methods.description: Checks if the note is marked as favorite.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite status of the note.

methods.name: getETag
methods.description: Returns the ETag of the note, if any.

methods.name: setETag
methods.description: Sets the ETag of the note.

methods.name: getExcerpt
methods.description: Returns the excerpt of the note.

methods.name: setExcerpt
methods.description: Sets the excerpt of the note.

methods.name: getScrollY
methods.description: Returns the scroll Y position.

methods.name: setScrollY
methods.description: Sets the scroll Y position.
